title: Funhouse Mirror
description: The carnival hall of warped mirrors over a live source. Each frame is redrawn as horizontal then vertical strips, every one stretched or squeezed by a distortion profile, so the image bulges out, pinches in, ripples and wobbles like a sheet of curved silvered glass. Pick a mirror — Wavy, Bulge, Pinch or a Carnival mix — and dial the distortion, ripple count, wobble speed and how much the vertical axis warps too. A filter: it warps whatever feeds it (camera, a dropped clip, the demo, or the layers below), and the mic can pump the distortion.
